summary.plain: Switzerland's largest research institute for natural and engineering sciences, home to one of the world's most powerful proton accelerators. It produces intense beams of muons used in precision searches for new physics.
summary.technical: Swiss multidisciplinary research institute (Villigen/Wurenlingen, Aargau), part of the ETH Domain; formed in 1988 from the merger of EIR and SIN; operates the HIPA ring cyclotron feeding muon and spallation-neutron sources used by MEG/MEG-II and (planned) Mu3e.
